summary: Adds verified HTTPS and optional client certificate authentication to the frontend NGINX connection to a deployment-provided backend gateway.
userImpact: Operators can secure same-origin API traffic between the bundled frontend proxy and their backend gateway.

instructions: Use a compatible frontend image and deployment manifests. The default upstream scheme is HTTP.

configuration: Set API_UPSTREAM_SCHEME=https, point API_UPSTREAM at the TLS endpoint, and configure optional trust and client certificate file paths.
security: HTTPS verifies the upstream certificate chain and hostname. mTLS uses deployment-mounted client credentials and requires upstream enforcement.
documentation: The deployment configuration reference covers upstream routing, certificate rotation, health probes, and Compose, Helm, and OpenShift setup.
knownLimitations: The deployment provides the TLS termination endpoint and owns the final hop to the HTTP backend.
rollback: Restore the previous upstream address and network access before rolling the frontend workloads. Clear TLS-only settings when restoring HTTP.
validation: Exercise HTTP, verified HTTPS, mTLS, certificate rejection, and independent frontend liveness in the container proxy. Render supported deployment manifests.
